title: Looks Like a Miniature Tree, but a Little too Fake
text:
Looks Like a Miniature Tree, but a Little too Fake. How do you make a boring space look better? I have been on a quest to make my office look more colorful and homier and I have been relying mostly on artwork and artificial plants to do the trick. One of the fake plants that now adorns my desktop is this fake bonsai tree from the Yoerm store.

First, let’s talk about the plusses. This fake tree does, indeed, look like a miniature version of an actual tree. It is presented in a rectangular base, which is good for a fake tree that slants in one direction. From a distance, the tree looks cool and the bright green color does look nice on an otherwise plain, boring, brown colored desktop.

Where this fake tree loses a few points with me is its overall appearance. Specifically, what I am referring to its level of fakeness. Once you get closer and examine, you quickly notice that the trunk of the tree looks like plastic. It doesn’t even look remotely real. The detail of the branches of the tree is nice, but again, it reminds me of an artificial Christmas tree.

It’s cool to have more color in my office décor but compared to the other fake plants I have, this bonsai tree is a little less appealing. The level of fake is the reason so if you’re the type who likes fake plants that at least provide the semblance of something genuine, you may want to pass on this one. Add up the pros and cons and you have an average decoration overall.
